name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian mass strike on 3–4 Nov hits power sites in nine Ukrainian regions; talks set for 10–11 Nov
state: Zelensky said Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic and 59 cruise missiles overnight into 4 Nov, mainly at power plants and substations in nine regions; Kovel lost most of its power and a strike on a Kharkiv hospital injured 73 (The Defense Post). Ukraine's air force said 272 of 310 drones were downed (Kyiv Post). A missile strike in Dnipro killed two on 4 Nov. US-mediated talks with both sides are set for 10–11 Nov in Abu Dhabi.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Attacks on energy infrastructure can affect European power and gas markets.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy infrastructure across nine regions = significant escalation, Alert
